applied.sql: select applied_at, company, title, hq, salary, fit, ghost, url from jobs where status in ('applied','interview','offer','rejected') order by applied_at desc

tonight.sql: select company, title, value, fit, ghost, ghost_why, status, url from jobs where status in ('staged','new','ready','needs_you') and fit >= 66 order by value desc limit 50

layoffs_at_target_companies.sql: select company, warn_count, warn_employees, warn_last, perm_cases, surge_note from company_signals order by warn_employees desc
